now.title: Agent Carter S2#4
now.text: Vernon Masters shuts down Peggy Carter's planned raid on the Arena Club with an executive order and an audit of the SSR. He spends his time in Los Angeles shielding the Council of Nine from her investigation.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An official who shuts down Peggy's raid and shields the Council of Nine.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent whose raid Masters shuts down to shield the Council of Nine.

proposed.text: Vernon Masters walks into the SSR office with FBI agents and halts Peggy Carter's planned raid on the Arena Club with an executive order and an audit. When she refuses to name her informant, he warns her that her allies may not survive the changes coming.

changes.evidence: Smoke & Mirrors (S2#4): Masters stops the Arena Club raid with an executive order and audit, takes Carter aside, asks who the informant was, and threatens that her allies may not survive the coming changes. The current second sentence ('He spends his time in Los Angeles shielding the Council of Nine') is a summary of his whole arc, not an event of this episode.

now.title: Agent Carter S2#5
now.text: In Los Angeles, Sousa and Jarvis become allies, working with Peggy Carter against Whitney Frost.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Howard's butler, now Sousa's ally against Whitney Frost.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An SSR agent, now Jarvis's ally against Whitney Frost.

proposed.text: At the Roxxon warehouse, Sousa talks Jarvis through pulling the uranium cores out of the bomb, and the two take the wounded Peggy Carter to Violet's house.

changes.evidence: The Atomic Job (S2#5): Jarvis is locked in with the bomb and Sousa instructs him how to isolate the uranium cores; afterwards Sousa and Jarvis take the impaled Carter to Violet for treatment. The current text is a generic summary ('become allies... against Whitney Frost'), not this episode's events between them.

now.title: Agent Carter S2#6
now.text: Working together to stop Whitney brings Daniel and Peggy closer.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The woman Sousa investigates with Peggy, which brings them closer.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The SSR chief in Los Angeles, investigating Whitney with Peggy.

proposed.title: Agent Carter S2#8
proposed.text: Sousa and Peggy Carter meet Whitney Frost to trade fake uranium rods for Jason Wilkes. When a dropped case exposes the fakes, Frost orders her men to kill them and gives chase.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The woman Sousa investigates, then tricks with fake uranium.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The SSR chief in Los Angeles, who tricks Whitney with fake uranium.

changes.evidence: Current text ('Working together to stop Whitney brings Daniel and Peggy closer') is about Sousa and Peggy, not Sousa and Frost, and nothing passes between Sousa and Frost in Life of the Party (S2#6), where he only monitors from a van. In The Edge of Mystery (S2#8) Carter and Sousa meet Frost and Manfredi for the exchange; the rods are revealed as fake and Frost orders them killed as they flee. Card lines also describe Sousa and Peggy growing closer rather than Sousa and Frost.

now.title: Agent Carter S2#8
now.text: Daniel Sousa and Peggy Carter fight their way past Joseph Manfredi's guards and pressure the mob boss into helping them against Whitney Frost, his former lover.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A mob boss, Whitney's ex, whom Sousa pressures into helping.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An SSR agent who pressures Manfredi into helping against Whitney.

proposed.text: Daniel Sousa and Peggy Carter fight their way past Joseph Manfredi's guards and threaten him into carrying an offer to Whitney Frost, his former lover: the uranium rods for Jason Wilkes.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An SSR agent who threatens Manfredi into carrying a message to Whitney.

changes.evidence: The Edge of Mystery (S2#8): Carter and Sousa defeat Manfredi's guards at Polizzi's; Sousa threatens to say Manfredi gave up Tommy Fontana, so Manfredi agrees to pass their trade offer (uranium for Wilkes) to Frost. He does not help them against Frost here; he stands with her at the exchange and orders his men to shoot them.

now.title: Agent Carter S2#8
now.text: When Jack catches Masters taking orders from Whitney Frost, Masters wipes his memory and sends his men to kill him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Jack's old mentor, who wipes his memory and tries to have him killed.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Masters's protege, who catches him taking Frost's orders.

proposed.text: When Jack catches Masters taking orders from Whitney Frost and confronts him, Masters wipes his memory with the memory inhibitor.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Jack's old mentor, who wipes his memory.

changes.evidence: The Edge of Mystery (S2#8): Thompson overhears Masters taking Frost's orders, confronts him, and Masters uses the Memory Inhibitor on him. Masters's men (Vega) saying they are not to let Thompson live comes in A Little Song and Dance (S2#9), a later title with no stage for this pair.

now.title: Agent Carter S2#9
now.text: Jack Thompson goes to Whitney Frost to tell her the Gamma Cannon is not ready, and her partner Joseph Manfredi calls him stupid and threatens him. Thompson is really stringing them along for Vernon Masters.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Whitney Frost's partner, who threatens Jack while being strung along by him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Manfredi threatens. Secretly strings Manfredi and Frost along for Masters.

proposed.text: Jack Thompson goes to Whitney Frost to tell her the Gamma Cannon is not ready, and her partner Joseph Manfredi calls him stupid and threatens him. Thompson is secretly plotting to blow up Frost along with Vernon Masters.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Manfredi threatens, who secretly plots to blow up Frost.

changes.evidence: A Little Song and Dance (S2#9): at the meeting Thompson betrays Masters to Frost (revealing Masters wants to use the cannon on her) and asks for a Council seat, while secretly having the cannon turned into a bomb to kill Frost, Masters and Wilkes. He is not stringing Manfredi and Frost along for Masters.

now.title: Agent Carter S2#9
now.text: Manfredi keeps Wilkes under guard while Frost forces him to work on her Zero Matter experiments.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Frost's partner, who kidnaps Wilkes and keeps him under guard.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The scientist Manfredi helps kidnap and keeps under guard for Frost.

proposed.text: Manfredi drags Wilkes out of the car and orders him to obey, then guards him while Frost tries to pull the Zero Matter out of him, at one point warning her that she will kill him.

changes.evidence: A Little Song and Dance (S2#9): Manfredi pulls Wilkes from the car and orders him to do as he is told, sets up the waste facility lab, and watches as Frost straps Wilkes down to extract the Zero Matter, recommending a pause before his heart gives out. Wilkes is the subject of the experiments, not forced to work on them.
